data.name: Eilis
data.gender_notes: Eilis is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word ‘eilidh’, which means ‘radiance’ or ‘shining light’. This name was traditionally given to Irish girls born during the light of the midsummer moon. The name Eilis carries the meaning “Light, radiance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eilis usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the light and love of God.
data.etymology: Eilis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, radiance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eilis total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: איליס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אליס הוא שם שמשמעותו אלוהים הוא ישועתי, נגזר מהמילה העברית 'אל' ו'ישוע'. זהו שם המשלב את השורשים העבריים לאלוהים וישועה, ומשמש כזכרון לאמונה באלוהים כמושיע.

in_greek.name: Εἰλις
in_greek.long_meaning: Εἰλις προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'אליס', που σημαίνει 'Θεός ἡ σωτηρία μου'. Στο πλαίσιο της Καινής Διαθήκης, το όνομα συνδέεται με την έννοια της σωτηρίας μέσω του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Eilis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eilis derivatur ex hebraeo 'אליס', quod significat 'Deus est salus mea'. Hoc nomen in traditione christiana significat fidem in Deum ut salvatorem.

in_english.name: Eilis
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eilis originates from the Hebrew 'אליס' (Elis), meaning 'God is my salvation'. It combines 'El' (אל), meaning God, and 'yeshua' (ישוע), meaning salvation. This name is significant in Christian tradition as a reminder of faith in God as the savior. Eilis reflects a strong spiritual meaning, symbolizing trust in divine providence and redemption through God.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Eilidh" was a popular choice in Ireland during the medieval period and carried significance as a symbol of hope and brightness. The 'E' sound in the name echoes themes of birth, renewal, and transformation. This name also has ties to the Celtic heritage, adding a rich historical and cultural background.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Eilis" (Eilidh) is rooted in its meaning of 'shining light' or 'radiance'. As a Christian name, it emphasizes the metaphorical light of God guiding and protecting an individual. The name can serve as a reminder to live in illumination and reflect the love and grace of God within their communities and everyday lives.
